authority: User explicitly accepted eight teacher fits followed by four student fits and instructed executing them on the existing 8xL4 cluster.

validation.ancestry: Only fitting train members may fit normalizers, teachers, initializers, priors or learned transformations.
validation.exposure: Previously inspected development valid; not fresh confirmation. No seq_ix chronology or replacement random folds.

teachers.initialization: Fresh fitting-only scratch for every teacher, not an all-corpus checkpoint or W18 warm continuation.
teachers.gru_prior_recipe: Native211 causal inputs, WMSE, batch32/chunk1000, peak LR1e-3 OneCycle5%warmup, gate-wise FP32 Muon plus AdamW elsewhere; exact source/flags freeze before fit.
teachers.transformer_recipe: Causal numerical Transformer dim384/layers8/heads8/context1024, AdamW, four epochs; adapt existing sequence/teacher runtime and freeze FFN/batch/LR before profile. No new trainer clone.
teachers.start_rule: Ready audited GRU controls/arms may start while the independent Transformer adapter finishes; one unready family must not block ready fits.

students.design: Two predeclared teacher families x two matched fitting seeds1001/1002. Freeze exact mixtures before teacher outcomes. Reuse eligible PR60 W18 controls if source/recipe identity matches.
students.recipe: Same train-only W18 GRU256x2/FBC initializer, FP32, AdamW1e-4, batch16/chunk2000,2epochs/fixedep1; change only declared teacher target relative to control.
students.teachers: Require fixed epoch3 train-only teacher artifacts and causal predictions; no validation gradients or valid-fitted weights.
students.disk_rule: Do not materialize every teacher's full train bank. Stream/reuse qualified caches and existing family arrays; no unrelated deletion or precision reduction.
students.exact_main_teacher_target: T_new=0.8*T_old+0.2*0.8125*mean(clip(new_family_prediction,-2,2)); native training then retains alpha0.7 and its existing clipping/weighting. The0.8125 factor preserves the old preweighted target amplitude.
students.wide_family: Equal mean of4 fixed-epoch3 teachers: GRU384x2 andGRU512x1 at seeds1001/1002
students.transformer_family: Equal mean of2 fixed-epoch3 causalTransformer teachers at seeds1001/1002
students.retained_auxiliary_targets: Existing qualified W18 four-family targets and family coefficient0.1 unchanged

invariants: Strict FP32 with no AMP/TF32/quantization for fitting and evaluation
Retain checkpoints/history and full official validation each epoch; best-observed distinct from fixed endpoint
Reuse existing numerical components, prediction/scoring/ownership/dashboard helpers; do not create another framework
Source/config/environment/inputs/parent hashes recorded before each profile/fit
Detached finite execution survives SSH disconnect and stops only receipt-owned processes
Preserve previous fits, PR60 results and failed attempts; no hidden refits
Publish per-cell outcomes/checkpoints/curves and final fixed-combination results to GitHub as SemyonEpanov

comparison.teacher_capacity: Matched fitting seeds and scratch controls; architecture/optimizer-family comparisons explicitly reflect unequal compute.
comparison.uncertainty: Allocation targets, not promised gains/significance. Two seeds share exposed development validation.
